targetReport.title: Lei nº 5.534, de 14 de novembro de 1968
targetReport.description: Principal legislation establishing the obligation of natural and legal persons under Brazilian jurisdiction to provide statistical information requested by the Fundação IBGE for the execution of the National Statistics Plan (Plano Nacional de Estatística). Still the foundational legal basis for mandatory response and statistical secrecy cited in all major IBGE operations including the Censo Demográfico.

targetReport.title: Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de México (SCNM) / System of National Accounts of Mexico
targetReport.description: Mexico’s national accounts system (annual + quarterly + monthly indicators). Explicitly follows SNA 2008. Includes Supply and Use Tables, institutional sector accounts, and multiple satellite accounts. Base year currently 2018 for many series (previous major bases 2013 and 2008).

_variants.description: Mexico’s integrated national accounts framework following SNA 2008. Includes annual and quarterly estimates, Supply and Use Tables, institutional sector accounts, satellite accounts (culture, health, non-profit, unpaid household work, tourism, etc.), and related short-term indicators. Current major base years include 2018 and earlier 2013/2008 benchmarks.
_variants.notes:
Central macroeconomic framework. Explicitly adopts SNA 2008.

Contextual material from INEGI methodology documents (SCNM base 2008 series): the calculations adopt and adapt the conceptual and accounting framework of the System of National Accounts approved by the United Nations Statistical Commission for 1968, 1993 and 2008, together with specific manuals. Annual calculations with base year 2008 produce the current and accumulation accounts recommended by SNA 2008 (goods and services accounts, institutional sector accounts, public-sector macroeconomic indicators, etc.).

IMF ROSC (2021) confirms: "The methodology followed is consistent with the System of National Accounts 2008 and the IMF’s Quarterly National Accounts Manual 2017."

targetReport._notes: Central macroeconomic framework. Strong links both to the domestic legal foundation and to the international SNA 2008 standard.
targetReport._why_qualifies: Mexico’s national accounts system (annual + quarterly + monthly indicators). Explicitly follows SNA 2008. targetReport._url_evidence: Retrieved and read: 'Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de Mexico. Guia rapida. Ano base 2018', published by INEGI. It is the SCNM described as a whole and matches the item point for point - annual accounts, quarterly products (sec. 6.1) and monthly indicators (sec. 6.2); explicit adoption of the SNA/SCN framework including the 2008 version; Cuadros de Oferta y Utilizacion and symmetric input-output matrices (sec. 3); Cuentas por Sectores Institucionales (sec. 5); and eight satellite accounts (sec. 7: culture, health, tourism, environmental-economic accounts and others) - all on base year 2018. This confirms the earlier finding that INEGI has no single SCNM landing page (temas/scnm, programas/scnm, programas/cn, temas/cn all return 'Pagina no encontrada', and both sitemaps named in inegi.org.mx/robots.txt - sitemap_contenidos_generales.xml and sitemap_programas.xml - themselves resolve to the 404 page), so INEGI's own system-wide reference document is recorded instead.

En este contexto, el INEGI describe el orden metodológico y las fuentes de información que utiliza para la elaboración
de las cuentas satélite, con apego a estándares internacionales como el mismo Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales
2008; el Sistema de Contabilidad Ambiental-Económica 2012 (SEEA), el SEEA Water; el Sistema Europeo para la
Recogida de Datos Económicos sobre el Medio Ambiente; la Cuenta Satélite de Turismo: recomendaciones sobre el
marco conceptual 2008; el Manual sobre las instituciones sin fines de lucro en el Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales;
el Sistema de Cuentas de Salud; la Propuesta para una Metodología para una Cuenta Satélite de la Producción
Doméstica; entre otros. Con lo anterior, la generación de información de interés nacional, como parte de las funciones del INEGI establecidas
en la Ley del SNIEG, se ve sustentada por el programa de cuentas satélite a cargo del Instituto, pues constituye una
parte importante del Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de México. Dichas cuentas están referidas a temas como salud,
vivienda, o recursos naturales, entre otras, las cuales se apegan a estándares estadísticos científicamente sustentados
y discutidos internacionalmente, como los citados en el párrafo anterior.

targetReport.title: Territorial Formula Financing
targetReport.description: The federal unconditional transfer to Yukon, the Northwest Territories and Nunavut that closes the gap between what a territory could raise on its own and what it needs to provide services comparable to those in the provinces, calculated under Part I.1 of the Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements Act and Part 1.1 of SOR/2007-303. The fourth major federal transfer alongside the Canada Health Transfer, the Canada Social Transfer and Equalization, and until this entry the only one of the four with no node in this graph. Its revenue-base formula at s. 19 mirrors the DIVISION 2 Nova Scotia formula at s. 8 term for term in several places (SEPH, the System of Macroeconomic Accounts wage terms, Government Finance Statistics), which is what made this pass cheap once the equalization-named-products cluster had already verified the parallel citations.
targetReport.cadence_note: Entitlements are announced in December for the fiscal year beginning the following April 1, alongside Equalization, from the same certificate process.

entries.covers: TFF entitlements for fiscal year 2027-28 (beginning April 1, 2027)

release_schedule.rule: Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-8), s. 4.3: "The territorial formula financing payment payable to a territory for a fiscal year shall be calculated, at a time determined by the Minister, no later than three months before that fiscal year begins."
release_schedule.note: Statutory deadline is 3 months before the fiscal year starts (i.e., no later than Dec 31), but in practice Finance Canada has announced TFF and Equalization entitlements earlier in December each year via a joint news release: FY2022-23 announced Dec 16, 2021; FY2023-24 announced Dec 2022; FY2024-25 announced Dec 2023; FY2025-26 announced Dec 23, 2024. The next occurrence (for FY2027-28) is therefore expected around mid-to-late December 2026, with Dec 31, 2026 as the hard statutory backstop.
